//: Which article trees the portal reads. Copy to `articles.json` (gitignored) or point ARTICLES_CONFIG at your own. The NAME is the identity: permissions and role mappings are keyed on it, so a tree that moves on disk keeps its configuration and one removed and re-added gets it back.
//path: A DEDICATED worktree, not somebody's working checkout. Reading a live tree means reading whatever branch a person happens to be on and whatever they have half-saved.
//refresh: The ref a tree is moved to before each sync. OMIT IT and the tree is never touched — that opt-in is what stops the sync moving a checkout somebody is working in.

repos.name: Read-Only Example
